name: Hybrid Isosurface/DVR Rendering
aliases: Hybrid isosurface rendering / direct volume rendering
definition: A rendering strategy for viewpoints inside the volume (e.g., virtual colonoscopy) that first finds an isosurface (e.g., colon wall) and then continues with Direct Volume Rendering (DVR) for structures behind it.
summary: Hybrid Isosurface/DVR Rendering combines surface rendering for near structures with volume rendering for internal details, setting itself apart by using the isosurface to define the integration start point.
